items.title: LCC Projects IPO a suitable bet for long term, say analysts; GMP at 23%
items.description: LCC Projects IPO: LCC's profitability metrics, decent valuations and improving debt profile propel analysts to assign a 'subscribe for long-term' rating to the IPO.

items.title: ARCIL IPO: Why analysts are mixed on ₹733-crore offer; GMP at 21%
items.description: Asset Reconstruction IPO price band is set at ₹132 to ₹139 per share. Investors can apply for one lot of 107 shares and its multiples thereof.

items.title: Steamhouse IPO: Analysts rate 'subscribe' on capacity expansion, cash flows
items.description: Steamhouse India has set the price band at ₹77-₹81 per share for its IPO.
